label: Ruckus ZoneFlex R320 indoor access point
description: Ruckus ZoneFlex R320 - indoor 802.11ac Wave 2 2x2:2 access point, one 1GbE RJ-45 port, 802.3af PoE (12.18 W max) or 12 VDC 1A (9.15 W), BeamFlex+ adaptive antenna, wall/ceiling/desk mount, 308 g.
notes: Source is CommScope/Ruckus's own **HTML datasheet** (`webresources.ruckuswireless.com/datasheets/<slug>/ds-ruckus-<slug>.html`), whose **PHYSICAL INTERFACES** table is machine-readable text - the 4gon product pages for these APs return no extractable content and the AP pages on ruckusnetworks.com are script-driven. The whole interface table is one line - '**Ethernet: 1 x 1GbE port, RJ-45**' - with no USB and no second port, and the power table gives both feed options with their own figures: '802.3af 12.18W' and 'DC input 12 VDC 1A 9.15W'. Both are recorded: an 802.3af PSE is enough, and DC is the cheaper draw. Radios are 2x2:2 802.11ac Wave 2 and this datasheet publishes no peak PHY rate, so neither radio carries a `speed` - unlike its T310 sibling, whose table does quote 300/867.
